evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly into estimate delivery with no concern discovery.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised because the question was never asked.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep mentions 27th and 28th are available but does not frame them against cheaper alternatives or ask about date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep states no deposit required and payment after move: 'So we didn't require any deposit. We will only take payment after the move is completed.' Then asks to get scheduled: 'the last thing I need to get this scheduled, if do you have the address for the storage unit?' — this is closer to booking logistics than an explicit ask like 'Would you like our help with your move?'

top_strength: Jules successfully closed the booking, confirmed key details (storage address, dates, arrival window), and explained the all-inclusive pricing model clearly, positioning Einstein's rate structure as simpler than hourly competitors with hidden fees.
coaching_note: This was a follow-up call where Jules skipped discovery entirely — no two-concerns question, no concern-led probing, no Two Promises step, and no final concerns check. On the next similar call, open with the two-concerns question even if you've spoken before, deliver the promises before the estimate, and close with 'What's still concerning you about this move?' before asking for the business.
